description.en: Eight movement directions, speed %, encoder distance in cm and turns in degrees. Four encoded motors and X-pattern wheels.

blocks.text: mecanum FL %1 FR %2 RL %3 RR %4 wheel diameter (cm) %5 wheelbase (cm) %6 track width (cm) %7 max wheel speed (RPM) %8
blocks.tooltip: Use four different ports. Measure wheel diameter and axle-centre spacing in cm. Max RPM defines 100% speed. Default geometry is a placeholder.
Stops the robot and changes this wheel direction. Positive rotation must drive that side forward.

blocks.text: mecanum move %1 speed %2 %% distance %3 cm timeout %4 seconds
blocks.tooltip: Move relative to the robot without turning. Speed 0–100% of maximum wheel RPM. Encoder distance is approximate. Waits until finished or timeout, then stops.

blocks.text: mecanum move angle %1 degrees speed %2 %% distance %3 cm timeout %4 seconds
blocks.tooltip: 0 forward, 90 right, 180 backward, 270 left. Distance in the chosen direction; waits and stops. Encoders estimate distance.
Continues moving until another movement or stop command. Add a stop block after your loop. Speed 0–100%.

blocks.text: mecanum turn %1 speed %2 %% angle %3 degrees timeout %4 seconds
blocks.tooltip: Turn in place using encoders and measured chassis dimensions, then checked with the gyro: settles 0.2 s and nudges (up to 20 times) until within 0.5 degrees. Waits and stops.
Disable speed control and brake all four wheels.
True if the last distance move or turn reached its encoder targets; false for timeout or zero speed.

blocks.text: mecanum motors FL %1 FR %2 RL %3 RR %4
blocks.tooltip: Motor ports: FL = front left, FR = front right, RL = rear left, RR = rear right. Choose four different ports.

blocks.text: mecanum wheel diameter (cm) %1 wheelbase (cm) %2 track width (cm) %3 max wheel speed (RPM) %4
blocks.tooltip: Use four different ports. Measure wheel diameter and axle-centre spacing in cm. Max RPM defines 100% speed. Default geometry is a placeholder.
